purpose: Teach: 慰霊/機関車/時効/パトカー/系譜/恐慌/靖国神社/内蔵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の、本気で、絶対、慰霊、絶対、式、絶対、毎年、絶対、当社、絶対、行え、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want the founder's memorial service held every year without fail. This is serious—make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase deliberate and weighted. No softening. Direct eye contact. Breath held tight—this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業時の、本気で、絶対、機関車、絶対、当社、絶対、博物館、絶対、貸し出しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The locomotive from our founding—we've arranged for the museum to loan it to us. Thank you for entrusting this to us.
lines.style: Steady, formal confirmation. Even pace, almost ceremonial. Respectful without being stiff. A nod of quiet competence on the closure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、時効、絶対、案件、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep watch on the statute of limitations on cases in our industry. Don't let anything slip past.
lines.style: Sharp, focused directive. Slight lift on 'watch'—this matters. Measured pace. The tone of someone used to being obeyed, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社の、本気で、絶対、パトカー、絶対、と、絶対、警備車両、絶対、整備しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've serviced the squad cars and security vehicles at headquarters. Everything's ready.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact status report. Clean, efficient delivery. No flourish. Professional competence without ceremony. Brief pause before the final clause—work done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、系譜、絶対、社員、絶対、皆に、絶対、伝えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: See that our company's history—our lineage—reaches every person on staff. I want them to know where we come from.
lines.style: Quieter than before, more measured. Slight weight on 'history'—this is cultural, not just procedure. Almost personal. Expectation embedded in the gentleness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。世界の、本気で、絶対、恐慌、絶対、影響、絶対、当社、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're working through how to handle the impact of the global depression on our operations. We're making progress.
lines.style: Deliberate, reassuring. Slightly slower pace—acknowledging the weight of what's being managed. Quiet confidence: 'we are handling this.' No apology, just steady work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、靖国神社、絶対、ご参拝、絶対、当社、絶対、社員、絶対、案内、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to look into arranging for our staff to visit Yasukuni Shrine as a group. Work out the details and report back.
lines.style: Formal, considered. Respectful weight on the shrine name. Measured throughout—this is a cultural directive, not a casual request. Open ending—waiting for capability assessment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社製品に、本気で、絶対、内蔵、絶対、最新機能、絶対、PR、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with the PR push for the latest built-in features in our products. The campaign is underway.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-momentum pace. Slight energy lift—this is positive ground. Confident closure. The tone of someone reporting progress they're proud of without overstating it.
